summary: The inspected proof interfaces preserve the guards exposed by the committed counterexamples. The repaired maximum-degree root choice makes the three size15 search branches exhaustive, the Q8 terminal step retains its separate mixed-triple exclusions, and the degree16 transfer uses actual deletion-set inclusion. No unsupported bridge was identified at this scope; full numerical reconstruction was not performed.

findings.statement: Core-four absence alone is insufficient for the P9+Q8 terminal conclusion; the active proof explicitly includes the necessary mixed-triple exclusions.
findings.disposition: The committed omitted-guard counterexample was independently verified, and the active plan's separate E3 stage and terminal trace interface were checked.

findings.statement: The new maximum-degree selection agrees with the size15 replayer's literal scopes: cap6 for two triangles, cap5 only when no degree6 point exists.
findings.disposition: This supports the proposed repair without claiming to dispose of the original writer's reviewer-owned finding.

findings.statement: Plan metadata and selected source-code interfaces were checked separately from coefficient reconstruction and complete finite replay.
findings.disposition: The bounded checks do not certify every original model row or rerun the entire computational proof.

checks.scope: Size15 exhaustive root choice and guarded support domain
checks.method: Compared the actual manuscript diff, R15-rho6-finite-closure.md and replay_r15_rho6_tree.py, check() initialization.

The replayer requires literal scope (n,cap,target,disjoint_cap,minimum_used_degree)=(11,6,15,6,3) for two triangles or (11,5,15,6,3) for the two five-edge types, checks the complete root seed, and reconstructs all 120 triples avoiding the root. checks.scope: Q8 acyclic plan, strict recorded bounds and terminal coverage
checks.method: Read D17-complete-argument.md and independently traversed the 94-node saved plan and coverage records with standard-library code; reconstructed the target mask sets rather than comparing counts alone.
checks.observation: Every listed antecedent precedes its node. Final E4_56 and E4_57 each use 68 earlier nodes; all 24 E3 nodes use exactly the first 70 nodes. Recorded claims comprise 80 strict trace-upper bounds and 14 negative zero-objective bounds. The unions of new absence masks equal all 715 core four-sets and all 231 mixed core triples. This checks saved claims and ancestry, not coefficient replay. Independently, all 132 disjoint covering pairs among 147 permitted terminal trace shapes require a pure-Y transversal.

checks.method: Rebuilt the committed P9+Q8 example using the literal 17 root cones and residuals {0,1,6,14} and {2,7,16,17}; tested every triple of its 19 members by literal pairwise intersections.
checks.observation: The family is SF4, has no residual core-four member, and has a disjoint residual pair with neither pure-Y triple. Its first residual has mixed core trace {0,1,6}; therefore it violates precisely the additional premise supplied by the active E3 stage. It refutes the weakened terminal inference but does not contradict the manuscript.

checks.scope: Degree16 graph-to-cover bridge and finite-domain composition
checks.method: Read D16-fibre-independent-preparation.md, D16-I8-deletion-cover-reconstruction.md and d16_fibre_reconstruction.cpp lines 110-133; independently checked the stated empty-fibre cyclic homomorphism on every edge for k=2 through 6.
checks.observation: The cyclic reduction preserves edges in every tested A_k-minus-one-vertex domain. The source distinguishes independent star support from nonindependent star enumeration and requires an actual degree16 point. For nonindependent support, code uses missing[i]=adj[i]&occupied and (missing[j]&~missing[i])==0, while q[i] sums actual star multiplicities; this is the required actual-set inclusion, not a cardinality comparison. Cover counting retains two exterior completions per support triple and applies the raw12-to10 correction through ambient triple-codegree incidence. The global degree partition and subsequent rho<=6, rho7, rho8 split remain exhaustive under their stated guards. No compiler or full census was run.
